info.title: Uptible management API
info.description: OAuth management API. Availability depends on configuration; OAuth is disabled by default. Scope and access are separate: a scope never grants access to another account. See the management guides for activation and retry semantics. The Uptible-API-Version response header identifies this compatible v1 contract; see api-compatibility.md for client requirements and support policy.

get.description: Owned notifications in ascending ID order, archived records included by default. Use mutually exclusive after/before cursors for bounded forward/backward navigation. next_after and previous_before are null at their respective ends. The website uses this same query/resource with limit=10.

post.summary: Create a notification with explicit draft or active intent
post.description: Defaults to draft. Explicit state=active requires current lifetime access. Same account, key and input returns the existing notification; changed input or creation intent conflicts. Keys remain reserved after deletion. An identical uncertain retry must retain its key; a deliberate payload/intent change must use a fresh key.

message.description: Updates store the message up to 191 code points and do not apply the 50-code-point create cut. The TrimStrings middleware removes leading and trailing whitespace and invisible characters (Laravel Str::trim), unless the submitted message exactly matches the stored message. An unchanged message is kept as stored.

session.name: uptible_session
session.description: First-party same-origin authenticated website session; cookie name follows server configuration. Mutations require the session X-CSRF-TOKEN header. Supported by notification management operations and DELETE /api/v1/leads/{id}. Lead GET operations remain OAuth-only. Any present Authorization header selects OAuth exclusively, including empty or whitespace values.

message.description: Required message. The TrimStrings middleware first removes leading and trailing whitespace and invisible characters (Laravel Str::trim: Unicode whitespace, zero width and joiner characters, soft hyphen, BOM, and similar). Creation stores the longest prefix of whole extended grapheme clusters within 50 Unicode code points. If the first cluster alone exceeds 50 code points, creation stores that cluster up to 191 code points and drops any following text. A first cluster longer than 191 code points is cut at a code-point boundary and may be split. A message of 50 code points or fewer is stored as trimmed. JSON containing invalid UTF-8 receives a 422 validation error. Updates have a separate 191-code-point limit and do not apply the create cut.

state.description: Creation intent. Active requires current lifetime access. The paid website explicitly requests active; unpaid users can create only draft.
